changelog: Version reflection: footer/About/modal show live module version via /api/version. Nodes: child nodes show a single clickable Managed-by card (metrics + Restart/Revoke, no parent containers); child dashboard hides cluster card; cluster card sums all nodes with weighted CPU. Upgrade: scope selector (this device / node / all) with per-node apply. Heartbeat: parent re-logs-in and retries stats when a child rejects the token; last_seen only updated on successful polls. Ankfile: heredoc RUN (<<EOF) parsed correctly and quoted through chroot. ank-alpinebase now ships as tar.gz and is extracted as a private copy per container - bind-mount fallback removed, shared base can no longer be polluted. Container card node badge no longer overwritten by status badge.
